diagnosis.what_happened: The script failed to enforce RTL in four OpenXML layers, including using w:val='1' on bidiVisual, misordering bidi in sectPr, ignoring settings.xml, and omitting bidi in cell paragraphs.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Incomplete and malformed RTL attribute injection caused MS Word to render tables with LTR column progression, despite passing partial validations.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Strict multi-layer RTL enforcement: empty <w:bidiVisual/>, ordered <w:bidi/> in sectPr, localized settings.xml, and <w:bidi w:val='1'/> in cell <w:pPr>.
diagnosis.rationale_why: OpenXML schema strictly defines element ordering (bidi before docGrid) and attributes (bidiVisual takes no val). Full RTL fidelity requires document, section, table, and paragraph level declarations.

desired_behavior: Enforce the 4-layer OpenXML RTL standard: 1) Inject <w:bidiVisual/> without w:val in tblPr. 2) Insert <w:bidi/> before <w:docGrid/> in w:sectPr. 3) Inject <w:themeFontLang w:bidi='fa-IR'/> in word/settings.xml. 4) Apply <w:bidi w:val='1'/> to all cell <w:pPr>. Validators must reject w:val on bidiVisual.
generalization: RTL in OpenXML is a multi-layered requirement spanning settings, sections, tables, and paragraphs. Partial or malformed injections (like w:val on bidiVisual) break rendering.

evidence.observed_value: RTL table direction failed in Chapter 4 docx
